title: Jackfruit Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy jackfruit taco recipe with a mix of Spanish and Mexican flavors.

ingredients.name: quenched
ingredients.notes: Use for tacos seasoning or to taste

ingredients.name: spanish
ingredients.notes: Paprika, cumin, or oregano work well

ingredients.name: salad
ingredients.notes: Mixed greens, radishes, and lime juice dressing

ingredients.name: tortillas
ingredients.notes: Corn or flour tortillas work well

instructions: Heat the jackfruit in a pan with 1 tablespoon quenched.
Add 1 teaspoon of Spanish or Mexican spice, to taste.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the jackfruit mixture onto a tortilla.
Top with salad, shredded cheese, and any other desired toppings.
Optional: Add diced onions, bell peppers, or other desired toppings.
For a spicy kick, add diced jalapeños or sliced hot peppers.
Garnish with cilantro or scallions for a fresh touch.
